headlines.title: What Is American Express (AXP) Signaling With New Rewards And Risk Leadership?
headlines.summary: American Express (NYSE:AXP) introduced new cash back redemption options that send rewards directly into high yield savings and business checking accounts. The issuer also appointed U.S. Bank's chief risk officer to lead American Express's global risk and compliance function. Management is tying cash back to deposit products and refreshing its risk leadership. However, this only captures part of today's news story.

headlines.title: Earnings Guidance Raised Might Change The Case For Investing In Amex Stock (AXP)
headlines.summary: American Express reported higher third quarter 2026 net income of US$3,712 million and raised full year earnings guidance while keeping revenue growth expectations unchanged. Fresh card partnerships with Airbnb and Albertsons expand American Express's travel and everyday spending reach, deepening its fee and rewards ecosystem across both premium and mass market customers.

headlines.title: AXP vs. MA: Which Payments Powerhouse Has Greater Potential?
headlines.summary: Mastercard outshines American Express with stronger growth forecasts, diversified revenues and lower credit risk, despite its premium valuation.

headlines.title: Restaurant Industry Celebrates Visionary Leaders Opening Doors to Opportunity for All
headlines.summary: Tuesday evening in Washington, D.C., the restaurant industry celebrated its visionary leaders building opportunity for all. The 2026 Restaurants Advance Leadership Awards honored four standout individuals whose work is opening doors, developing careers, and strengthening the communities they serve.

description: American Express Company, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an integrated payments company in the United States, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, the Asia Pacific, Australia, New Zealand, Latin America, Canada, the Caribbean, and internationally. It operates through four segments: U.S. Consumer Services, Commercial Services, International Card Services, and Global Merchant and Network Services. The company offers credit and charge cards and complementary products and services, including travel, dining, and lifestyle and expense management products and services; and banking and other payment and financing products and services, including deposits and non-card lending. It also provides merchant acquisition and processing, servicing and settlement, fraud prevention, and point-of-sale marketing and information products and services, as well as network services. The company offers its products and services to consumers, small businesses, mid-sized companies, and large corporations through mobile and online applications, affiliate marketing, customer referral programs, third-party service providers and business partners, in-house sales teams, direct mail, telephone, and direct response advertising. American Express Company was founded in 1850 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
